sources.entry: UGCFast - AI UGC video ad generator with 300+ AI actors and 35+ languages, built for performance marketers shipping TikTok, Reels, and Meta ads.

summary.name: UGCFast
summary.one_liner: UGCFast is an AI UGC video generator that turns a product link or description into a short, lip-synced, user-generated-content-style ad with an AI presenter for TikTok and Meta.
use_cases: Creating TikTok and Meta ad variations without booking creators
Turning an Amazon or Shopify product page into a video ad draft
Testing multiple hooks and ad angles quickly
Localizing ad scripts into other languages
Generating scroll-stopping opening lines for short-form ads
Producing 9:16 captioned ads for Reels and Shorts
summary.what_it_does: UGCFast takes a product image, a pasted Shopify or Amazon URL, or a text description and builds an editable ad draft with a script and hook. The user picks an AI presenter from a library of 100+ actors across age, appearance, language, and vibe, and the presenter is lip-synced to the voiceover. Output is a 9:16 MP4 with captions and voiceover for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, or Meta Ads. The site also offers free tools for generating TikTok hooks, writing UGC scripts, and creating a draft video from a URL.
notable: Product URL to editable ad draft with AI presenter and voiceover
Free hook generator and script tools
One-time $1 trial credit valid for 7 days, no subscription
Presenter library of 100+ AI actors and 10+ voice languages
caveats: Paid plans start at $39/month with 15 credits; the $1 trial is a single temporary credit
Product-in-hand generation and 10-video batch are in private beta, available soon
Longer videos and higher resolutions consume more credits
